Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified the “fifth section of federal rules alphabetically” as the Federal Rules of Bankruptcy Procedure and proceeded down that path. The correct fifth section is the Federal Rules of Evidence. This early, unverified assumption redirected all subsequent steps to the wrong ruleset (e.g., FRBP 9017/9014) and led to the erroneous final conclusion about amendments, directly causing the wrong solution.
